title: Twist E24: Base-field Jacobian arithmetic and independent arbitrary-class replay
status_note: Partial local evidence, 2026-10-23; full experiment blocked and unfunded. Independent PARI replay passes all 5,855 original divisor classes and both norms. Balanced base-field arithmetic, formal chart bridge and independent-host replay remain open. Complete raw publication awaits artifact-store credentials.

question: How much of the present cover cost comes from the Fp6 chart, and do arbitrary-class maps replay in an independent same-field representation?
decision_value: A verified base-field stage improvement enables a correctly priced cover pipeline comparison. Missing independent arithmetic or exceptional charts leaves transfer validation partial. No destination decomposition solver is supplied merely by changing charts.
